raw.readme_excerpt:
# Agent Autoloop

**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)

![架构图](docs/architecture.svg)

## 它解决什么问题？

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。

- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。

## 上手

支持 macOS 和 Linux。运行前需要装好 Node 24、Git、curl，以及任意一个你已经登录好的命令行 Agent，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以直接把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)丢给你的 Agent，让它替你装好。

> **Windows 版：待定。** 很多朋友在问 Windows 版，我都看到了。我现在人在外面出差，手边没有 Windows 电脑，没法真机开发和测试，所以现在还不能在 Windows 上用。这个周末（11 月 7、8 日）回家后，我会把它开发完，做完兼容性测试，再正式推出。进度会更新在 [#17](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/issues/17)。等不及的话可以先用 WSL2，注意事项见 [INSTALL](INSTALL.md)。

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```

安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。

装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：

```bash
agent-autoloop try
```

下面是在终端里的真实输出：

```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……

Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。

【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1 <序号>
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```

交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。

## 一件事怎么转起来

编号和上面的架构图一一对应：

1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。

能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。

## 日常怎么配？

### 写一份规则（`rules.json`）

不需要写胶水代码。打开 `~/.agent-autoloop/rules.json`，在 `rules` 里写清楚**什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干**。`to` 填 `agents` 里已有的名字。比如每天早上 9 点写早报：

```json
{
  "name": "早报",
  "when": { "cron": "0 9 * * *" },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/notes",
  "prompt": "整理昨天的笔记和提交，写今天的早报。"
}
```

外部事件写法一样，只是要先接好来源。比如有人提新 Issue 时交给 Codex，先按[说明](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#接一个事件插件)在 `sources` 里登记 `github`：

```json
{
  "name": "处理 issue",
  "when": { "source": "github", "types": ["issues.opened"] },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/code/app",
  "skill": "handle-issue",
  "parallel": 3
}
```

保存后几秒内自动生效，可以运行 `agent-autoloop check` 检查；`agent-autoloop rules explain` 看生效的规则和下次定时，`agent-autoloop emit <类型> --dry-run` 预演一条事件会派给谁（不连接中台、不写日志）。就算改错了，或者文件被删、读不到，系统也会继续按旧规则跑，并发卡片提醒你。

### Agent 怎么跟中台配合？

中台对 Agent 只有一个约定：**在最后一条回复里交代结果**。事情办完了，正常输出一句结论就行。需要向你请示时，在回复末尾附一段 `agent-autoloop` 代码块：

````text
订单已经核对完毕，库存充足。

```agent-autoloop
{
  "ask": [{
    "title": "怎么发货？",
    "text": "两种方式今天都能发出。",
    "options": ["快递", "自提"],
    "key": "shipping"
  }]
}
```
````

除了提问（`ask`），还能发通知（`notice`）、关闭已解决的卡片（`resolve`）、预约复查（`later`）和触发新事件（`events`）。通告不需要回答，但结案时可以顺手写一句处理说明，这句话会留在卡片上；只是告诉一声的通告标成 `fyi`，不带按钮。万一 JSON 写错了，中台只让它在原会话里重写最后这段回复，不会把已经干完的业务重做一遍；重写也失败时，保留原结论并通知你回执没有生效（通用命令没有会话，直接走这一步）。接着旧会话跑也一样：会话接不上才开新的；接上了、干到一半断了，就算没跑成，过几分钟回到原会话重试，不开新会话重做。同一事项的新事件默认开新会话；规则写 `"resume": true` 就接着上一轮的会话。

## 拿来即用的场景模板

每套模板都带规则、任务 Skill 和启用说明。

| 想做什么 | 已经封装好的流程 |
|---|---|
| [每日早报](examples/recipes/morning-brief/README.md) | 默认每天 8 点整理本地笔记和 Git 提交，写入 `briefs/YYYY-MM-DD.md` |
| [跟进 GitHub Issue](examples/recipes/github-issues/README.md) | 每 5 分钟查新 Issue，在本地改代码并通知你查看；不提交、不推送、不回复 Issue |
| [线上告警排查](examples/recipes/ops-alerts/README.md) | 接收报错、对照代码查原因，需要重启时发卡片询问，回答后继续 |
| [用户反馈处理](examples/recipes/feedback/README.md) | 重读反馈当前状态、修复、交付核实、准备回复；需要决定时飞书问你，回答后继续 |
| [网站巡检](examples/recipes/website-watch/README.md) | 每 5 分钟检查状态和关键内容，首次异常交给 Agent，持续

raw.readme_excerpt:
# teardown

A Claude Code skill that turns any machine into a 3D simulator you can take apart.

Ask how something works. Claude builds it as one offline HTML page: the machine runs in the middle, every panel around it reads the real numbers, a button opens the part doing the work, and when nobody touches it the page tours itself.

![Mellis HB-7 robotic bee simulator](docs/bee.gif)

| Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion | Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus |
|---|---|
| ![Telson SC-8 robotic scorpion](docs/scorpion.gif) | ![Pelagos OC-8 robotic octopus](docs/octopus.gif) |

## Install

```
npx skills add elvarofficial/teardown -g -a claude-code
```

Then, once, in the installed folder:

```
npm install && npx playwright install chromium
```

You need Node.js 20 or newer. For the video you also need `ffmpeg`, and for the sound Python 3.

## Use

Ask Claude Code in plain words:

> Build me a simulator of a 4-stroke motorcycle engine I can take apart.

> How does a mechanical watch keep time? Show me as a simulator.

> Make a teardown of a hydraulic excavator arm and record a 20-second video of it.

Or open one of the 3 examples first:

```
node sims/build.mjs v8-live          # teardown-out/dist/v8-live.html
node sims/build.mjs cessna-live
node sims/build.mjs strandbeest-live
```

## What is inside

| | |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | What Claude reads: how a machine is built, the rules that make it look right, the review loop. |
| `sims/kit/` | Runtime, stage, shader warm-up. |
| `sims/v8-*`, `sims/cessna-*`, `sims/strandbeest-*` | 3 complete machines. `-shared` is the machine, `-live` the page you drive, `-film` the recorded tour. |
| `sims/build.mjs` | Bundles a machine into one HTML file, three.js and fonts inlined. |
| `sims/capture.mjs` | Renders the film frame by frame to a 60 fps mp4, or to review sheets of stills. |
| `sfx/`, `run_sfx.py` | Procedural sound on the film's timeline, mastered to −14 LUFS. |

## Credits

Built on [whaleyxbt/claude-motion](https://github.com/whaleyxbt/claude-motion) (MIT): the runtime, frame capture, sound engine and review rules come from there. Recorded samples are CC0 from Freesound, prepared by [Barty-Bart/motion-graphics](https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics); sources in `sfx/samples/SOURCES.md`.

MIT licence.

# NOIR

[![build](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Verlintas/NOIR)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Verlintas/NOIR)](LICENSE)
![platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-macOS%20%7C%20Windows%20%7C%20Linux-2ea44f)
[![AtomGit](https://img.shields.io/badge/AtomGit-Verlintas%2FNOIR-2f81f7)](https://atomgit.com/Verlintas/NOIR)

**把「这台手机到底能泄露什么」变成一份可复现的报告。**

NOIR 是一个跑在电脑上的审计工具，通过 `adb` 读取已连接 Android 设备的应用清单、权限和 APK 里的网络端点，给出分类、风险评分和可执行的处置建议。它也可以在需要时调用 `jadx` 对单个应用做反编译和关键字检索。

> 定位：**审计与自我防护**。面向自己的设备、自己的应用、已授权的安全研究。

**官网 / Website:** https://verlintas.dev/noir/ · [中文](https://verlintas.dev/noir/zh/)

**AtomGit 镜像 / Mirror:** https://atomgit.com/Verlintas/NOIR

---

## 它做什么

1. **盘点**：列出所有「有网络权限 + 敏感权限」的应用，以及它们各自拿到了什么。
2. **抽取端点**：在设备端用 `unzip + strings` 从每个 APK 的 dex 里提取 URL，只回传几 KB，不把整包拉回电脑。
3. **分类与打分**：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。
4. **数据关联**：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。
5. **共享 UID**：识别 `android.uid.system` 这类共享用户，列出哪些包实际上共享同一套权限并集。
6. **清单层**：解析 `AndroidManifest.xml` 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。
4. **给建议**：区分「可安全自动执行」「需人工确认」「不建议动」，并为每条动作生成回滚命令。
5. **必要时深挖**：`deep` 会把单个 APK 拉到本地，用 `jadx` 反编译后检索 `Runtime.exec`、`setApplicationEnabledSetting`、`DexClassLoader`、`MediaProjection` 等高风险调用。

## 它不做什么

- 不联网、不上传任何数据、不需要账号。
- 不修改系统分区，不需要 root。
- 不会自动卸载任何东西，除非你显式加 `--aggressive`。

---

## 第一次运行

```bash
noir
```

不带参数会进入向导：

1. 检查 `adb`，没有就**问你要不要自动下载**（`~/.noir/tools`）
2. 检查设备，没有就打印**开发者模式 / USB 调试的开通步骤**，然后**等你插线**（最多 180 秒）
3. 问一句「开始扫描?」，扫完直接出仪表盘
4. 问一句「执行这 19 条安全处置?」，`y` 就执行，并写好回滚文件

全程只会问两三个 y/n，其余都是自动的。

## 环境自检

```bash
noir doctor
```

```
NOIR doctor
  platform  Mac OS X aarch64
  java      17.0.19
  adb       /opt/homebrew/.../platform-tools/adb
            Version 37.0.1-15733141
  device    178b0d2f  device  2509FPN0BC
  jadx      /opt/homebrew/bin/jadx
```

```bash
noir setup          # 缺什么下什么
noir setup --yes    # 不询问，适合脚本
```

## 出现问题时

所有错误都会带「怎么办」，而不是抛异常栈：

```
╭─ ERROR ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ 指定的 adb 不存在：/nonexistent/adb                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 检查路径，或运行 noir setup 自动安装。                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

没有设备时给出的是可执行步骤：

```
╭─ 没有检测到设备 ──────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│  1. 打开开发者模式                                           │
│     小米 / HyperOS：设置 → 我的设备 → 全部参数 → 连点「MIUI 版本」7 次
│  2. 开启 USB 调试：设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项 → USB 调试        │
│  3. 插线后手机弹「允许 USB 调试吗？」→ 勾选「一律允许」        │
│  4. 还不行就换一根数据线（很多线只能充电）                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
```

已连接但没授权时，会单独提示「撤销 USB 调试授权后重插」。

## 支持平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| macOS (Intel / Apple Silicon) | ✅ |
| Windows 10 / 11 | ✅ |
| Debian / Ubuntu | ✅ |

依赖：

- **JDK 17+**
- **Android platform-tools**（`adb`）
- **jadx**（仅 `deep` 命令需要）

程序会自动在常见安装位置查找 `adb` 和 `jadx`；找不到时可以用 `--adb` / `--jadx` 指定。

```bash
# macOS
brew install --cask android-platform-tools jadx

# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo apt install adb
# jadx: https://github.com/skylot/jadx/releases

# Windows (scoop)
scoop install adb jadx
```

---

## 安装

**方式一：下载即用（推荐）**

到 [Releases](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/releases) 下载对应平台的 portable 包：

```
noir-v0.1.1-macOS-portable.zip
noir-v0.1.1-Windows-portable.zip
noir-v0.1.1-Linux-portable.zip
SHA256SUMS.txt
```

解压后**双击启动器**即可，包内自带运行时，**不需要安装 Java**：

raw.readme_excerpt: # florilegium [![build](https://github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![playground](https://github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium/actions/workflows/pages.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://kevinraymond.github.io/florilegium/) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kevinraymond/florilegium?color=2456c4)](https://github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium/releases/latest) [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/kevinraymond/florilegium?color=2456c4)](LICENSE) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium) Procedurally generated Delft-blue floral page margins for LaTeX. No images, no imported paths, no external assets: every petal, leaf and stem is a curve computed while the page is being written, painted like a watercolor, and written straight into the PDF. Every page grows a garden of its own, and every document its own plants, each sampled from a genome. ![six seeds](gallery/seeds.gif) *Six seeds of the grown margin. Same code, different seed, and the garden fills whatever space the text leaves free.* **[Try it in your browser](https://kevinraymond.github.io/florilegium/)** · [download the package and the PDFs](https://github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium/releases/latest) · [documentation](#documentation) ## Origin The [Reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/LaTeX/comments/1xixznw/how_do_you_make_these_flowers_in_latex/) asked how to make flowers like these in LaTeX. I don't know how the original was made. This project is one possible way. The way I did it first, in 1.3, uses hand-authored primitives with randomized parameters, painted in Lua and placed by a procedural layout whose "fill the unused space" part borrows a 1998 idea from the ornament literature. In 2.0 the plants and animals of the grown margin are sampled from genomes of botanical traits, so what grows is procedural too, not only where it grows. It gets a similar look, but I explicitly tried to not replicate the original. This project was made with the assistance of AI (Claude), and I'm sharing the [process I used](PROCESS.md) to bring it to life. ## Quick start With LuaLaTeX, put `florilegium.sty` and the `florilegium*.lua` files beside your document (or upload them to an [Overleaf](https://www.overleaf.com) project set to LuaLaTeX). They are all in [`florilegium.zip`](https://github.com/kevinraymond/florilegium/releases/latest/download/florilegium.zip), with the TikZ library and the manual: ```latex \usepackage[a4paper,left=68mm,right=22mm]{geometry} % a wide margin for the garden \usepackage[grown,sections]{florilegium} % flowers at the headings, too \definecolor{ink}{HTML}{5B2A1F} % optional: any hue (this is sepia) ... \florilegiuminitial[4]{T}his paragraph starts with a decorated T. \florilegiumtextend % at the very end: fill the space below ``` With pdfLaTeX, or in any TikZ picture, the TikZ library draws the same species in pure TikZ (it needs only its two `tikzlibraryflorilegium*.code.tex` files): ```latex \usepackage{tikz} \usetikzlibrary{florilegium} \begin{tikzpicture} \pic {florilegium plants={plants={3/rose, 17/umbellifer, 29/mustard}, size=21cm, width=6cm}}; \end{tikzpicture} ``` [Using the package](docs/usage.md) lists every option and command. ## The documents | | `florilegium-grow.tex` | `florilegium.tex` | |---|---|---| | composition | **grown**: plants grown to fit the page by a greedy space-filling loop | **authored**: stems, leaves and flowers placed by hand, every parameter sampled | | adapts to | the page layout, and the free space below the text on the last page | nothing (tuned for A4, 68 mm margin) | | preview | |

raw.readme_excerpt:
# Claude Animated Shorts

The free Claude skill from the video **"How to Make Viral Animated Shorts Using Claude (Full Workflow)"**.

It makes 55-70 s vertical animated story shorts: 2D characters in a colourful 3D world, with ink outlines, a painted town, lens blur, gliding cameras, a march score and sound effects. Everything is rendered with three.js inside Remotion on your own PC, with no AI video generator.

Proven on **The Bridge That Fell for a Song**, a 67 s short about the 1831 Broughton bridge.

## What's inside
| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | The skill: the full pipeline, every rule, every fix, and the final look values |
| `templates/bridge/` | The full source of the bridge short: world, characters, ink, lens blur, grade, story/camera |
| `templates/audio/` | The synthesized sound: SFX, march music, the mix with ducking and loudness |
| `templates/scripts/` | Stills, side-by-side sheets, shot merge and frame-by-frame QA helpers |
| `references/STYLE_BIBLE.md` | The script and visual formula measured from 20 reference shorts |
| `references/reports/` | Seven measured reports: motion, depth, textures, characters, lighting, outlines, grade |
| `references/frames/` | 38 full-size reference frames (540x960) to compare your frames against |
| `references/sheets/` | 20 contact sheets, one per reference short, 60 frames each (1,200 frames) |

## Install
1. Copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/cartoon-3d-short/` (clone it there, or download the ZIP).
2. You need [Remotion](https://www.remotion.dev/) with `@remotion/three`, plus Node, Python 3 and ffmpeg.
3. In Claude Code, say: *"Use the cartoon short skill and make a short about …"*.

Claude then follows `SKILL.md`: topic and facts, then script, then voice, then the shot plan in `story.ts`, then stills, then renders. Agents check your frames against the reports and the frames, and you get the final 2K render and sound mix.

## Notes
- Set `REMOTION_TMP` to a folder on a big drive. Every Remotion bundle copies `public/` (~1.3 GB) into the temp folder.
- Story, characters and voice should always be your own. Use the references for the look, not the content.

## License
The code and docs are MIT (see `LICENSE`). The reference frames are included for style study only.

raw.readme_excerpt:
reanimate

Reverse-engineer animations you like. Build your own on top.
A Claude Code skill that works from a live site, a screen recording, an mp4, a gif or a Lottie file.

A short demo. Watch the full video.

A lot of good ideas start on someone else's site. Ask an agent to rebuild one from a link or a screenshot and it makes one pass, calls it done, and misses. It can't see the motion or tell how far off it is. reanimate records the original, rebuilds it in your code, then records the copy the same way and compares the two. Each round shows what's still off, so the agent keeps going until the numbers match. You end up with a close starting point to make your own.

Three cards from stripe.com. Top: the original. Bottom: the copy, filmed the same way.

## Install ```sh npx skills add NiazMorshed2007/reanimate -g ``` The [skills CLI](https://skills.sh) asks which agents to set up; add `-a claude-code` to skip the question. Then, in Claude Code, say what you want, where it is and where it should go: ```text /reanimate the hero entrance on https://example.com, into components/Hero.tsx /reanimate this loader, 0:03 to 0:05 of ~/Downloads/loader.mov /reanimate the card hover in this gif, match it exactly /reanimate the logo marquee from https://example.com, with our logos and pause on hover ``` Needs [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.1 or later, on macOS or Linux (Windows is untested). The first run installs a static ffmpeg into the skill's folder and Playwright's Chromium into Playwright's usual cache, about 250 MB together. No API keys. Other agents that read `SKILL.md` can install it too, but it has only been tested with Claude Code. ## How it works 1. **Record.** It films the reference in a headless browser at a fixed viewport and frame rate: a video, numbered frames, every CSS and Web Animations API animation it finds, and the position of chosen elements on every frame. For canvas and WebGL it also traces the GPU calls (shaders, uniforms, draw calls, the three.js scene) on a virtual clock that makes every capture identical. 2. **Spec.** One row per element per property: start, duration, from → to, easing, stagger. analysis.uniqueness: Использует собственный UI‑движок GPUI, обеспечивает нативную производительность и хранение в формате, совместимом с популярными корпоративными сервисами.
cons: Наличие 3 высоких уязвимостей в отчёте безопасности
Документация ограничена README и небольшими примерами
